name: Watashi wa Neko ni Naritai
source:
This is a story about suddenly turning into a cat, meeting a mysterious chicken, and spending your days getting picked up by people as you prowl around town.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1235400/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于突然变成一只猫，遇到一只神秘的鸡，并在城镇中徘徊并被人们捡起的日子的故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1235400/]Steam[/url]]
